children: Yext reported second-quarter fiscal 2027 results with revenue of $111.1 million and net income of $13.1 million (basic EPS $0.13). The company reported Adjusted EBITDA of $34.0 million (31% margin) and ARR of $440.8 million, and completed the acquisition of GoShine while unveiling a working prototype of Corvo AI. Yext said enterprise ARR cohort retention and expansion improved in the quarter and highlighted continued capital returns to shareholders.
Revenue: $111.1 million for the three months ended July 31, 2026.
Gross profit: $83.8 million (gross profit reported; gross margin not separately stated).
Income from operations: $17.6 million for the quarter.
Net income: $13.1 million; net income per share, basic: $0.13 for the quarter.
Adjusted EBITDA: $34.0 million for the quarter; Adjusted EBITDA margin reported at 31%.
Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR): $440.8 million as of July 31, 2026.
Completed acquisition of GoShine to expand the platform into brand-level visibility optimization for AI search.
Released a working prototype of Corvo AI (askcorvo.com) in August, a conversational platform aimed at bringing Yext’s marketing agents to small business owners.
Reported acceleration in growth for the enterprise ARR customer cohort driven by improved retention and expansion.
Dollar-based net retention: 98% for customers with $50,000 or more ARR; total customers net retention at 96% as of July 31, 2026.
Operational focus on embedding more AI into the platform and expanding API and MCP offerings to facilitate partner and developer integrations.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.
